name: Residue
tagline: Learns which sound environments help you focus and builds a personal study profile.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: Study tools time sessions but do not learn how a student studies best, such as the right noise level.
solution: Analyses ambient sound during study sessions alongside privacy-preserving productivity signals, builds a focus profile, suggests soundscapes and tracks phone distraction.
demo_moment: Team-described: start a Focus session and see whether the room is mismatched for the goal.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” among 307 submissions.
Measures how you study, not just how long.

lessons: Reframe a familiar tool around the variable nobody measures.
